subject: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@bluefin-analytics.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluefin-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Bluefin_MAP_v0.9.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed focused on the load/performance validation milestone. High-level asks in this thread: pick preferred test windows, confirm who will own the replay artifact delivery, and agree a target close date for the MAP.

Summary (short):
- Milestone: Traffic replay load test (replay recorded prod traffic to simulate peak QPS)
- Proposed windows: Aug 24–26 (low-impact verification) and Sep 02 (final validation / go/no-go) — please confirm.
- Redwood owners: SE (Vivek) to manage harness & capacity; CS (Marissa) to run validation checklist.
- Bluefin owners: infra (Samir) to provide replay artifacts (S3 link) and approve VPC/network access.
- Estimated dedicated sizing: see attached capacity_estimate.pdf — preliminary recommendation 8xA100-equivalent GPUs for headroom on peak 600–800 QPS.

Target MAP close date: 2027-09-03 (we'll adjust if you need more runway).

Next steps (please reply with):
1) Which of the proposed windows work for Bluefin?
2) Who is Samir's point for S3/Secure transfer and any privacy redactions?
3) Any constraints around test account data retention / masking (PII)?

Attachments: Bluefin_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (MAP workbook), capacity_estimate.pdf (preliminary sizing)

Thanks — I’ll pause until we have window confirmation then Vivek will share the replay harness instructions.

— Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@bluefin-analytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluefin-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners

Chloe — thanks for the recap and the MAP. A few clarifying points from our side before we lock windows: 

- Peak profile: our internal telemetry shows peak 95th percentile at ~620 QPS, short spikes to ~820 QPS for ~45s during batch close. We want the test to reproduce both the sustained and spike behaviour.
- Replay artifacts: we can provide anonymized request logs to S3; security needs to confirm masking rules (PII must be stripped or tokenized).
- Private deployment requirement: we prefer the private/VPC option for the replay to avoid egress of masked logs. If Redwood's harness can run inside our VPC or via an agent we can make that work.

Can Vivek share the replay approach & minimal artifacts you need? Also, what's the pretest—do you recommend a small-scale pretest first (10% traffic) before the full run?

Samir
Director, Infrastructure | Bluefin Analytics
samir.p@bluefin-analytics.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@bluefin-analytics.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners

Thanks Samir — good details. Short answers and what we need: 

1) Replay approach: we support two modes — remote replay (Redwood-hosted harness pulls anonymized logs from your S3) or VPC-agent (we deploy a lightweight replay agent in your VPC that performs traffic replay against a private deployment). VPC-agent reduces data movement and matches your preference.

2) Artifacts we need from Bluefin: one week of request logs around a typical week (gzipped JSON lines), schema map for requests, auth tokens/keys (securely rotated), and any request transformation rules. We can provide a sample ingest script.

3) Pretest recommendation: yes — run a 10% traffic pretest for sanity (30–60 minutes) before the full-scale run. That helps validate KV cache behavior and warm the model.

4) Sizing guidance: based on the profiles, we recommend an initial dedicated pool equivalent to 8xA100 for the full run to keep token latency under 200ms p95; for the pretest a 2x–3x subset works. We'll include a more detailed CPU/network concurrency plan in the replay docs.

I’ve attached replay_harness_instructions.md which includes the minimal S3 layout and sample pretest_config.json.

Next steps I can take as Redwood SE: schedule technical runbook call with your infra, share a short checklist for the pretest and confirm the VPC-agent installation window.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@bluefin-analytics.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-17T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners

Looping in the ops checklist you can expect from Redwood CS. A few operational items that are MAP dependencies: 

- Test accounts: we’ll need 2 test API keys (functional + validation) and a staging dataset mapping.
- Metrics & tracing: please enable the requestId header in logs and provide a sampling of traces to help correlate latency spikes.
- Canary & rollback: we will run a canary ramp (10% -> 40% -> 100%) during the run with automated abort thresholds (errors > 3% or p95 latency > 500ms).
- Data handling: Bluefin to confirm masking; Redwood can run with masked logs only — legal signoff required.

Proposed concrete windows (to reduce churn):
- Pretest (10%): Aug 25 22:00–23:30 UTC
- Full-scale run: Aug 26 02:00–04:00 UTC (UTC windows minimize regional work hours)

If those are OK I’ll add them to the MAP and create the Jira ticket for scheduling. Assignments: Vivek = SE lead; Marissa = CS lead; Chloe = commercial owner. Bluefin infra = Samir.

Attachment: pretest_config.json (sample), checklist stub in MAP workbook.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluefin-analytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-17T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners

Thanks everyone — windows look reasonable. We prefer the Aug 25 pretest at 22:00 UTC and the Aug 26 full run window you proposed (02:00–04:00 UTC). Samir will provide the anonymized logs to s3 by EOD Aug 20.

Couple of asks from procurement/security: 
- Can you provide an estimated incremental cost for reserved/dedicated capacity for the test days? We don’t need an exact invoice, just an estimate to get PO approval.
- Will Redwood commit to the rollback/canary thresholds noted? Need that in writing for our ops playbook.

We can do 10% pretest first. If the pretest looks green, we’ll proceed to the full run as scheduled.

— Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops | Bluefin Analytics
elena.ruiz@bluefin-analytics.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluefin-analytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@bluefin-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18T15:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Load/Performance test — scheduling & owners

Great — confirmed then:

- Pretest (10%): 2027-08-25 22:00 UTC — Redwood to run pretest harness against anonymized logs.
- Full run: 2027-08-26 02:00–04:00 UTC (UTC) — Redwood SE will ramp per canary plan.
- Owners: Vivek (SE lead), Marissa (CS lead), Chloe (commercial owner), Samir (Bluefin infra lead).
- Target MAP close date: 2027-09-03.

Action items (owner / due):
- Samir: upload anonymized logs to s3://bluefin-secure-samples/ (due 2027-08-20)
- Vivek: send VPC-agent install instructions + replay checklist (done; see replay_harness_instructions.md) (due 2027-08-19)
- Marissa: create scheduling Jira & attach MAP workbook (due 2027-08-19)
- Chloe: prepare draft statement of costs / estimate and ship to Elena (due 2027-08-19)

Related links: HubSpot deal and MAP folder attached in thread metadata. Please reply to confirm ownerships or flag if any dates need changing — otherwise I’ll treat this as lock and update the MAP workbook accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to the runs and the validation results.

— Chloe Martin
